item.title: [IGNITE-7021] IgniteOOM is not propogated to client in case of implicit transaction
item.description:
it's related to https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/IGNITE-7019
when transaction fails due IgniteOOM, ignite tries to rollback transaction and it fails too, because can't add free pages to free list due a new IgniteOOM:
